product_name_specific: Crème C.T.R. Diana Améliore l’aspect des traces de taches de Rousseur et d‘acné
risk_description: The product poses a chemical risk because it contains mercury (measured value: 8061 mg/kg). Mercury accumulates in the body and can damage the kidneys, brain and nervous system. Additionally, it may affect reproduction and the unborn child.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Cosmetic Products Regulation.
